anthropic_output_excerpt:
TITLE: The Unspoken Language of K-Drama Silence and Eye Contact

A first-class passenger from Singapore once asked me why Korean dramas linger so long on faces saying nothing. She had been watching on the screen in front of her for three hours. No headphones. Just watching the expressions.

Sabina's Story

✈️ Hi, I'm Sabina. During my 23 years working as a flight attendant, I served routes between Seoul, Hong Kong, and Dubai. Long-haul passengers always had time to notice things. That question from Singapore stayed with me for the rest of the flight.
